objective: Create the Style 9 golden concept as a dense layered-comparison poster explaining how backpressure makes production respond to actual processing capacity.

confirmed: Without backpressure, continued production can outpace consumption, grow queued work, and increase processing delay.
With backpressure, consumer capacity and buffer-watermark state produce a feedback signal that regulates upstream production.
Memory protection, more stable latency, and lower cascading-failure risk are presented as intended benefits rather than absolute guarantees.
simplifications: Use one upper comparison band for the no-backpressure condition and one lower band for the feedback-controlled condition.
Represent production, buffering, consumption, and feedback as generic technical modules without vendor-specific protocols or deployment details.
blocked: Do not claim zero delay, perfect stability, guaranteed safety, benchmark values, queue sizes, rates, protocols, vendors, or implementation-specific behavior.
Do not copy the approved cover's central request-processing core, four numbered responsibility-zone topology, bottom four-capability rail, example icons, or semantic story.
Do not add people, robots, AI brains, dashboards, glass devices, isometric scenes, decorative code, extra stages, or any text outside the frozen copy ledger.
Do not add an explanatory paragraph, caption strip, footer sentence, takeaway rail, legend, slogan, prose annotation, or unlabeled module.

composition.canvas: fully opaque 16:9 pure white or slightly cool-white technical poster
composition.hierarchy: one oversized deep navy Chinese title across the upper band; one compact orange-accented upper comparison row for the uncontrolled condition; one larger royal-blue and engineering-green lower feedback loop; one right-side benefit summary stack
composition.upper_band: 没有背压 leads from 持续生产 to 队列积压 to 处理延迟上升 using a clear left-to-right orange exception path
composition.lower_band: 引入背压 organizes exactly three named modules—消费能力, 缓冲水位, and 反馈信号—into one explicit closed feedback loop; the green return arrow travels directly from 反馈信号 back to 消费能力 with no intermediate node, chip, box, caption, or label
composition.benefit_stack: three distinct supported benefit cells for 保护内存, 稳定延迟, and 降低级联故障风险
composition.paths: royal blue for primary controlled flow, engineering green for supported feedback and benefit states, orange for the uncontrolled accumulation path
composition.density: body-infographic density with eighty-five to ninety-two percent intentional occupancy, clear grouping, and no empty decorative dashboard panels
composition.reading_order: title, upper uncontrolled comparison, lower feedback loop, benefit summary; terminate the composition after the three benefit cells with no footer or explanatory strip
